name: Local git
covers: Status, diff, log, branches, commit report
credentialNote: No server. The commands run git, the one optional exception to running no other program; the repo root and branch are read in pure JS

supported.note: Runs the git already on PATH. toil needs git 2.24 or later for its argument safeguards and refuses an older one with GIT_NOT_FOUND; output parsing was checked against git 2.49.
